description: Index of all scraped data files in this /data directory. Update this file whenever a new dataset is added.
how_to_use: Read this file first to see what data already exists before scraping or re-scraping anything.

datasets.notes: Click/rotation settings per brewing method for 227 grinder models. Some models use non-numeric rotation notation preserved verbatim in each entry's notes field.
Weight/grind-size variant pricing not exposed in static page fetch; only base prices captured.
Includes 5 sampler/bundle products (flagged with bundle: true) alongside 29 single-origin/blend coffees.

Includes 4 wholesale-size (10kg) bundle duplicates of existing products (flagged bundle: true) and 2 Nespresso-compatible capsule products, alongside 21 retail coffee products. Several products had no explicit in-stock/sold-out indicator on the page (availability: null).

All Chikmagalur/Coorg single-estate coffees with unusually detailed processing notes (anaerobic/culture/pineapple/frozen-cherry fermentation). 500g pricing was often not separately itemized on product pages (only 250g and 1kg); left null rather than interpolated. No explicit stock-status indicator on most pages.

Excludes 3 pure promotional 'free item with purchase' listings (not real products). Includes 3 bundle products (sampler boxes, gift hamper) flagged bundle: true. Heavy on experimental microlot processing (jasmine co-ferment, rose petal fermentation, anaerobic naturals) from Chikmagalur estates; 340g/800g variant prices frequently not shown separately (percentage discount stated but base price absent) — left null.

Small catalog, every core coffee product was sold out at scrape time. Same coffees also sold as separate 'Hot/Cold Brew Bags' product listings and the site sells non-coffee equipment (grinders, espresso machine, matcha) — not included in this file.

All Bababudangiri/Chikmagalur origin (Baarbara & Balanoor Estates) plus chicory filter-coffee blends. About half the 'Speciality Coffee' single-lot products (Anaerobic Natural, Carbonic, Dark Room Naturals, Karadykan Naturals, Kondadkan Estate, Robusta Royale, Whiskey/Rum Barrel Aged) had no description text at all on their product pages — thin content on the source site, not a scraping gap. Pricing shows one 'from' figure per product, identical across 250g/500g/1kg since no per-weight breakdown was exposed.

Largest and most processing-detailed catalog scraped so far — heavily dominated by Ratnagiri Estate experimental microlots (culture process, carbonic maceration, thermal shock, nitrogen maceration, sugar/herb fermentation) with Brix and fermentation-hour data. Nearly the entire 44-product catalog was sold out at scrape time. Includes 4 instant-brew sachet products at the end. Reached via a Google share-link redirect (share.google/mnyrFEP2chLaJ30OT -> coffeeverse.in).
